messages:
ash: T-minus 40m for the change window. Quick heads-up: we have a requested freeze extension for an extra 30m from infra. Need quick consent so we can adjust pin timing.

maria: Why the extra 30m? Does this affect the DB migration lock?

kevin: We saw a node replacement in us-central that slowed autoscaler spin-up. Infra wants ambient headroom before we hit high QPS. 30m keeps the reserved pool warm.

devon: Canaries are ok but note embeddings warmup in eu had higher tail latency during the last trial. If we stretch freeze, we should run another short embedding smoke after pin.

ash: OK. Proposal: extend freeze by 30m, but pin sequence delayed by 10m so we can validate warmup. If anyone objects, speak now. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

maria: Fine by me, as long as DB migration remains at 2m lock and is executed during low traffic window (we're still inside that).

tom: I'll move the rollout schedule: plan to pin eu-west first, then stagger us-central after 8m. Will prepare deploy-bot commands.

deploy-bot: Note: to pin per-region use --region flag. Sample:
```
/deploy pin --service api --version v2.7.1 --region eu-west-1 --owner @tom --reason "launch window + freeze ext"
```

kevin: Also recommend applying temporary alert suppression for non-critical noise for the first 15m post-pin. I'll open the suppression and annotate it.

ash: Who's oncall for the first 25m? We need a single escalation path.

kevin: I'll lead initial watch (0-25m), devon backup (25-60m). Maria handles customer comms.

maria: I'll craft a short support blurb ready to post. If we decide to rollback, I'll post an update with timeframe and next steps.

devon: Can we lock the model routing so embeddings routes hit dedicated pool if needed? I want that toggle ready.

ash: Yes — preflight toggle is ready in console. Maria, if we see regressions we flip routing->embeddings to dedicated and throttle batching.

tom: Pin sequence I'll run when we hit go: 1) /deploy pin eu-west 2) wait 8m verify metrics & smoke 3) /deploy pin us-central 4) expand to global.

devon: Add one smoke step: run small eval against the critical prompt set immediately after each pin. deploy-bot can run it automatically.

deploy-bot: smoke tests will auto-run post-pin. Failing evals will post results to this thread and set a marker: "EVAL_FAIL".

ash: Rollback triggers (short): sustained error rate > 2.5% for 5m OR p95 latency +250ms sustained for 5m OR eval fail with degraded scoring on golden set. If triggered, call rollback and deploy-bot will unpin and run rollback playbook.

kevin: Confirmed. I'll pre-stage rollback playbook and keep faster rollback cadence (aim <5m from decision to action).

maria: Freeze extension approved. I'm updating release notes with the extension and a short note about the migration lock.

deploy-bot: Pin scheduled: awaiting manual execute by @tom.

ash: Alright team — freeze +30m is approved. Tom, execute eu-west pin when ready and shout when smoke starts. We'll watch for 12m before proceeding to us-central.

tom: Running eu-west pin now.

deploy-bot: Pin executed by @tom at 5250001360 -- service=api region=eu-west-1 version=v2.7.1

ash: eu-west pinned. Running smoke now. Keep alerts muted for non-critical thresholds.

sre-bot: Alert suppression in effect for 15m per @kevin.

kevin: Metrics look stable at +6m. No error increase. Proceeding to us-central in 2m.

tom: Kicking us-central pin.

deploy-bot: Pin executed by @tom at 5250001425 -- service=api region=us-central1 version=v2.7.1

ash: All region pins done. Proceeding to gradual rollout. Channel stays hot for 45m. Call rollback if triggers hit.

maria: Posting support notice now. Good luck everyone.

devon: Monitoring evals. Will flag any semantic regressions.

-- thread end --
